integrity: Includes full proof, two independent exact-graph checking programs and their actual output; decoded artifact lengths and hashes recorded at packaging.
scientific_limitations: Labelled hub-containing wheel configurations; source claims of all-cardinality polynomial for cycles are excluded. The 2016 paired-domination polynomial publication was only available as an abstract, leaving historical priority risk. Finite checkers were supplemented by a symbolic proof and Fibonacci bijection. No independent validation.
title: Fibonacci backup multiplicities of hub-containing paired domination in wheels
